designSpec: A sound lesson pairs a playable original tone fixture with notation, a precise transcript, and a working local listening question.
template:
<Card size="sm" gap={4}>
  <Box gap={2}>
    <Row gap={2}><Icon name="headphones" /><Caption value={sampleLabel} /></Row>
    <Title value={title} size="sm" /><Text value={intro} size="sm" />
  </Box>
  <AudioPlayer src={audioSrc} title={audioTitle} subtitle={audioSubtitle} autoPlay={false} loop={false} />
  <Tabs tabs={tabs}>
    <Tabs.Panel id="notes"><Col gap={3}>
      <Grid columns={3} gap={2}><Each $of="notes" item="note"><Grid.Item><Box background="surface-secondary" padding={3} radius="lg" gap={1} align="center"><Text value={note.name} size="lg" weight="semibold" /><Caption value={note.frequency} /></Box></Grid.Item></Each></Grid>
      <Math value={relationship} /><Text value={noteDescription} size="sm" />
    </Col></Tabs.Panel>
    <Tabs.Panel id="transcript"><Timeline items={transcript} /></Tabs.Panel>
  </Tabs>
  <Col gap={2}>
    <Text value={question} size="sm" weight="semibold" />
    <RadioGroup name="direction" ariaLabel={question} options={choices} $onChangeAction='{ updateState: { answer: value } }' />
    <Show $when="has(answer)"><Callout color={answer === 'up' ? 'info' : 'neutral'} title={answer === 'up' ? correctTitle : retryTitle} description={answer === 'up' ? correctText : retryText} /></Show>
  </Col>
</Card>

data.title: Three notes, moving upward
data.intro: Listen for three separate pitches. Replay as often as you like, then describe their direction.
data.noteDescription: The three tones outline a C-major triad. Higher frequency corresponds to the higher pitch in this sample.

transcript.title: C4
transcript.description: A 261.6256 Hz tone, then a short pause.

transcript.title: E4
transcript.description: A 329.6276 Hz tone, then a short pause.

transcript.title: G4
transcript.description: A 391.9954 Hz tone, followed by silence.

data.question: Which way do the pitches move?
data.correctText: Each note has a higher frequency than the one before it.
data.retryText: Compare the first and last tones, then choose again.
